page.overview:
Who is Jacoba Brink?

Jacoba Brink is a former world-class Soviet figure skater hired by Aris Kristatos to train his young protégé, Bibi Dahl, to win the gold medal at the upcoming Olympics. A supporting character portrayed by the late British actress, Jill Bennett, she appeared in the 1981 James Bond film, For Your Eyes Only, and was subsequently adapted for the 1983-87 tabletop role-playing game, James Bond 007: Role-Playing In Her Majesty's Secret Service.

Aris Kristatos' recent financial investment, ice-skater Bibi Dahl spends most of her days training for the upcoming Olympics. Working to a strict training regime set by her coach, Jacoba Brink who was a world-class skater, Bibi has very little freedom to do what a girl of her age desires, but generally accepts Brink's regimen in hopes of one day competing in the Olympics. Kristatos seems to be a father figure, saying that if Bibi wins the gold medal it will be the apex of his life.

Continuing her training at Kristatos' retreat in the mountains of Greece, Bibi has become tired of her sponsors lack of enthusiasm for her Olympic success. When Kristatos tells her he plans to move to Cuba, Bibi becomes defensive with Kristatos saying that Cuba has hardly any reputation for winter sports.

Shortly after, Bibi decides to leave the retreat. Packing her bags, Brink tells her she will never leave her side. When Brink joins forces with Bond, an unaware Bibi presumes Kristatos is holding her captive; confronting her sponsor, she takes a hard slap to the face after telling Kristatos to go to hell.
